voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Liverpool, eighteen ninety-three. The White Star steamer Naronic sailed for New York, with seventy-four people aboard.
She never arrived. Three weeks later, two of her lifeboats were found adrift in the Atlantic.
One upside down. One half full of water. No one in either.
Messages in bottles turned up. One claimed an iceberg, in a blinding snowstorm. None of the names could be matched to anyone aboard.
The cause was never determined. Her wreck has never been found.
